text: Start with the request's imagery requirement. When a creation or change request asks for new imagery or artwork variants, plan actual generated image components and the requested number of distinct outputs … Existing imagery, a flat token fill or native gradient does not fulfill a request for new artwork.
note: Third copy of the "new imagery needs generation" rule (A1 step 3, D1).

text: When imagery is optional, choose whether a suitable real image, a generated component or typography alone best carries the message. A type-led concept can still use a generated background.
Preserve the inspected reference's material, blur, tonal depth and texture when those qualities define the chosen direction; palette similarity alone is insufficient.
note: Conditional on "the chosen direction" — the agent chooses the direction, so the brand's look binds only if the agent already decided to keep it. In the revamp it decided not to.

text: Read components.md for native text/geometry and independent authentic logo/product layers. Keep those editable and inspect the finished composition as well as every generated component.
